name: MITRE CVE Program
description: The foundational vulnerability identification system operating a multi-stage review process. CVE IDs serve as permanent, publicly verifiable records of vulnerability discovery recognized globally.

peerReview.processDescription: Multi-stage review: Content team review, Matching against existing records, Refinement/editing, CVE ID assignment, Proposal and voting, Final publication. Public comment period and community voting. CNAs must follow CVE ID Assignment Rules.

attribution.attributionNotes: CVE IDs are permanent, publicly verifiable records. CVE Credit system acknowledges reporters.

povsAlignment.description: Foundational vulnerability identification system providing permanent, publicly verifiable CVE records.
